messages:
maria: RFC follow-up: converging on a single tracing/metrics/log schema + cost attribution tags. I posted the draft proposal in the RFC doc. Need quick sign-off on the interface boundaries and rollout plan.
aj: Quick clarifying q — does this include background/async jobs (embeddings, batch jobs)? how do we attribute cost for multi-model requests?
vikram: We should avoid per-token high-card tags. Propose two layers: request-level canonical tags (low-cardinality) + sampled detailed traces for token-level perf.
lina: Pipeline note: current log pipeline flattens nested JSON and drops arrays. We'll need to preserve structured spans or add a migration. Who owns the mapping between routing keys and billing/cost centers?
maria: Proposal (example reserved fields) — please use these exact names to avoid drift:
```
# example span tags (reserved)
service: 'inference-runtime'
env: 'prod'
model.name: 'redwood-xl-1'
model.version: '2026-03-01'
cost.center: 'platform-ml'
request.id: '...'
request.type: 'chat'  # chat|embedding|batch
tokens.input: 42
tokens.output: 128
latency.total_ms: 123
```
aj: Who computes cost.center? per-customer mapping at ingress or later? Also how do we handle multi-tenant batch jobs that combine requests?
vikram: Map at ingress whenever possible; add fallback resolver in the enrichment pipeline for ambiguous cases. For multi-model requests, include a `model.variants` field with low-cardinality identifiers, but compute cost attribution via weighted token counts in billing pipelines. Also add a sampling header so we don't forward full traces for everything.
observability-bot: CI: schema-linter passed for services: runtime, router, batch-svc. 2 warnings about missing request.type in older clients.
lina: Rollout plan suggestion: 1) Add required tags at ingress + runtime (canary on staging), 2) Update pipeline to keep nested JSON and add enrichers, 3) Enable sampling + detailed trace export for 1% traffic, 4) Run cost attribution jobs and validate with billing data, 5) Full rollout.
maria: Action items: @aj draft mapping table for route -> cost.center (include multi-model rules); @vikram implement sampling header and add header propagation; @lina update pipeline schema migration doc and coordinate with infra for ingestion capacity. I'll schedule RFC review next Wed 10am.
aj: SGTM. Sampling header name?
vikram: Use `x-rd-sample` (values: 0|1|weight). Keep it simple.
lina: :thumbsup: Also reminder: never log raw prompt text or PII in spans. Mask at ingress.
maria: Agree. One more guardrail: freeze field names by next Friday and add a linter in the schema repo. If anyone objects to the reserved field names above speak up now. :eyes:
